_doc: AI tuning harness thresholds (AI_SPEC 12.2-12.5), read by --ai-harness (src/selftest_ai_harness.cpp, runner tools/run_ai_harness.sh). Each entry names a metric of the result JSON (dotted path, e.g. frameMs.p95) and a bound: lt (<), max (<=), gt (>), min (>=); a bound of "jog" is the jog speed from content/settings/movement.json. severity: fail (default; a miss makes the run exit 1), warn (reported, never fails) or off. "maps" overrides any entry per map tag (village, course, random, or the map file's name).

soak._doc: AI_SPEC 12.3: 32 bots, 20 minutes, on both default maps and a large random blank map. Per-bot figures divide by every AI bot (attackers and defenders), the deaths figure by attacking bots.

stuckPerBotPer10Min.note: AI_SPEC 12.3: < 1 stuck event per bot per 10 minutes

stuckOver5s.note: AI_SPEC 12.3: no stuck event lasting more than 5 s (open events of living bots at the end count)

stuckUnrecovered.note: AI_SPEC 3.6: every stuck spot is fixed at the source

exposedUnderFireShareOfTime.note: AI_SPEC 12.3: attackers under fire without cover within 5 m < 10 % of their time ([DECISION] W6b: of the attacking bots' living time, as the spec words it)

exposedUnderFireFraction.note: the stricter reading: < 10 % of their time under fire (reported, not a fail)

boundExposureMean_s.note: AI_SPEC 12.3: average exposure per bound < 3 s

nearestTeammateWhileAdvancing_m.note: AI_SPEC 12.3: >= 8 m to the nearest teammate while advancing

advanceSpeedMean_mps.note: AI_SPEC 12.3: at least jog speed while advancing

grenadesHurtTeammate.note: AI_SPEC 12.3: no grenade that hurts a teammate

objectiveFall_s.note: AI_SPEC 12.5: each objective falls within 4-10 minutes of its phase start (Regular, all-bot match); a phase held past 10 minutes is a miss

aiMainThreadMs.p95.note: AI_SPEC 11: <= 3 ms AI main-thread time per frame on min spec (this machine is not min spec)

frameMs.p95.note: frame time (wall clock, includes rendering); the GPU may be shared with other processes

baseline._doc: AI_SPEC 12.5: compared with the saved baseline of the old grid AI (AI_SPEC 2.2, --baseline-ai). file is relative to the repo root (found from the exe / working directory upwards, from NMK_SRC, or given with --baseline). report: metrics listed side by side; compare: bounds as a ratio of the baseline value.

attackerDeathsPerBotPerMin.note: AI_SPEC 12.5: deaths per minute for attacking bots fall clearly ([DECISION] clearly = at least 25 % fewer per attacking bot)

course._doc: AI_SPEC 12.2: attackers spawned on one side reach the other side and clear the building and bunker, with zero unrecovered stuck events. timeout_s ends the run.

reachedFraction.note: attacker lives that reached the far side (the objective's front half or beyond)

buildingsCleared.note: the two-room building and the bunker cleared room by room

forbiddenSamples.note: no bot ever stands in the marked minefield or the wire (outside a link traversal)

rebuild._doc: AI_SPEC 12.4: a wire belt, a bunker and a wall dropped across a group of moving bots: every affected bot re-routes within 1 s and none walk into the new object. Each drop goes across the route of the moving attacker with the longest route left, dropAhead_m in front of it; count objects spacing_m apart across the route, ahead_m further along it, yaw added to the route heading.

navRebuildMsMax.note: tile rebuilds run on the worker threads

maps._doc: Per-map overrides, keyed by map tag. Example: "omaha": { "soak": { "objectiveFall_s": { "min": 240, "max": 720 } } }
